verdict.rationale: Vestd shows only narrow, UI-level batch actions: distributing equity from a share pool to "one or more recipients" in a single action (vestd-docs-8), and sending updates to segmented groups of stakeholders through mailing lists (vestd-docs-3). The HRIS integration (vestd-docs-10) suggests automated syncing of employee data, but it is not described as a bulk operation, and no public API or OpenAPI spec was found (vestd-probe-3). Missing for 10: a general bulk-edit or bulk-action capability across many records (e.g. grants, shareholders, documents), programmatic or API-driven bulk operations, CSV or batch import details beyond the migration marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
